messages.name: papnoute
messages.content:
Antony heard a reading in church. "Sell what you possess and give to the poor... come, follow me." He took it as spoken to him that hour, not to whoever else was listening.

That is the seed of it. Not a philosophy of withdrawal. A word heard as addressed.

What follows from that is simple to state and hard to live. A village holds a person up on every side — neighbors, kin, the shape of a day already decided by others. That holding-up is also a hiding place. As long as it stands, a person can mistake the noise around them for the trouble that is actually within them. Remove it, and there is nowhere left to put the blame.

So we went out. Not to escape hunger or work — we found both waiting for us there too. We went to become reachable by the word again, without a village's worth of familiar things standing between us and it.
